1\. Trusted host validation removed 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
create_url_adapter no longer applies TRUSTED_HOSTS or validates the incoming Host, and no
replacement enforcement exists in Flask's request class. Applications relying on this setting will
accept untrusted hosts, exposing host-derived URLs and redirects to Host-header manipulation.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The PR removes the only enforcement of Flask's `TRUSTED_HOSTS` configuration, causing configured host restrictions to be silently ignored. ## Issue Context Restore the default configuration entry and ensure the configured trusted-host list is applied before routing binds to the request environment. If host handling is moved into `Request`, account for request-context construction occurring before the application context is pushed, and add coverage proving an untrusted Host receives a 400 response. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/app.py[177-207] - src/flask/app.py[423-459] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
